scenes.big: Red or green? Are you sure?
scenes.say: Red or green? Are you sure? Some people really can't tell the difference, and many don't even know it.

scenes.en: The retina has 3 types of colour-sensing cells. If one works differently, colours look alike.
scenes.say: Your retina has three types of colour sensing cells, for red, green and blue. If one type works differently, some colours look alike.

scenes.en: Studies show about 1 in 12 men, but only about 1 in 200 women, have it.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show about one in twelve men have colour vision deficiency, but only about one in two hundred women.

scenes.en: The common type passes down on the X chromosome. Men have only one X.
scenes.say: That's because the common type is passed down on the X chromosome. Men have only one X, so there's no backup copy.

scenes.en: Usually from birth. Doesn't get worse. It is not blindness.
scenes.ta: பிறவியிலிருந்தே இருக்கும், இது பார்வை இழப்பு அல்ல
scenes.say: It's usually present from birth, it doesn't get worse, and it is not blindness. Most people live completely normal lives.

scenes.en: A quick colour plate test during an eye test. Helps kids at school and some jobs.
scenes.say: A quick colour plate test, during an eye test, can find it. It helps children at school, and matters for some jobs.

scenes.en: Colours suddenly look faded, especially in one eye.
scenes.ta: திடீரென நிறம் மங்கினால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்!
scenes.say: But if colours suddenly look faded or washed out, especially in one eye, see an eye specialist quickly. Book an eye test today.
